correctness.rationale: Differentiated each component of the specified polynomial vector field: diagonal Jacobian entries −σ,−1,−b,−d,−4b. Thus divergence is identically −σ−1−5b−d. Liouville/Jacobi determinant formula gives det Dφ_T=exp[−(σ+1+5b+d)T] on every finite existence interval. Taking singular-value logs divided by T forces the sum of ALL five finite-time Lyapunov rates exactly; full asymptotic limits inherit it. Exact independent Fraction arithmetic at σ=10, b=8/3,d=19/3 yields −92/3; the two printed lists sum −16447/5000 and −71247/5000, discrepancies 410659/15000 and 246259/15000. Neither difference is a four-decimal rounding issue. A standard full 5-tuple is contradicted; no chaos/no-chaos reversal inferred.
residual_risks: A paper-specific undocumented nonstandard diagnostic could be intended by the phrase “Lyapunov exponents at 500th second”; claim is expressly about the standard full tangent spectrum.

value.rationale: Although Liouville’s determinant law is textbook, applying it to the TWO concrete full five-component spectra that the 2023 article uses as primary quantitative support for the model’s dynamical regimes reveals order-10 to order-27 rate violations. This is a substantive reproducibility fault in a published numerical investigation, not a tiny normalization/type check; the correction carefully avoids unsupported claims about chaos or new exponent tuples.
residual_risks: No corrected spectra or diagnosis of the numerical integrator is supplied; qualitative chaotic-regime conclusions might remain true.

final_claim: For the exact printed five-dimensional Lorenz ODE of Mao–Feng–Al-Towailb–Saberi-Nik, its constant trace imposes sum of all five standard tangent Lyapunov rates −92/3 at the stated parameters, whereas printed r=43 and r=25 five-number vectors sum −3.2894 and −14.2494; neither can be a full standard spectrum for the ODE.
limitations: Exact exclusion is of standard complete finite-time/asymptotic Lyapunov spectra for the printed equations and time variable; the plotted diagnostic’s implementation is unknown.
The generic divergence-sum theorem is prior mathematics; only the demonstrated published-number contradiction is assessed as original.
